content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Macon

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour and degree requirements for the PMP credential to confirm you meet the baseline qualifications before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Hours of Formal Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend all sessions from your location in Macon—no travel required. Our active certified practitioners deliver the full curriculum, preparing you for exam content across all process groups and knowledge areas.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, submit your PMP application directly to PMI. Include your education, project experience, and proof of Granite PM Academy's 35 contact hours. Pay PMI's exam fee and await eligibility verification before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides tailored to the PMP blueprint. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE once PMI approves your application, and sit for the four-hour computerized test at an authorized testing center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP is valid for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, project work, or volunteering. Renew before expiration by submitting your earned PDUs and maintaining your PMI membership in good standing.
